immutability: This protocol precedes any independently verified paired-depth outcome tape being accessed by Lane C; revisions require a new version/commit before accessing new outcomes.

analysis_period.validation: prospective only; old 005I sealed HOLDOUT never reused for tuning

features: As defined at exact PR #223; decisions must not use source-published/reception times or price/depth that were unavailable at the decision; accepted SAME/COMPLEMENT SIG orientation; thresholds fixed in code before prospective tape.

sample_gate.no_valid_sample: INSUFFICIENT_DATA; all economics except no-trade control NULL

economic_gate.net_pnl_ci_type: two-way event and day clustered; no individual quote-event iid bootstrap
economic_gate.entry_and_exit: authoritatively matched real fills/fees/cancellations or genuine independent prospective PAPER order outcomes with explicitly empirical fill calibration, never midpoint/touch
economic_gate.unresolved_order_rule: reserve worst-case cash, gross and fees until authoritative terminal state; no fabricated fill/zero payout; block realised PnL and capacity while unresolved
economic_gate.notional_cost_scenarios: fee schedule must be venue independently verified; unknown fees = reject
economic_gate.capacity: minimum share-sized quantile across empirically observed arrival depth/queue; report ceiling null until market impact and maker participation validated

stress_matrix.requirements: no positive claim where any stress is unobserved or negative

disposition_rules.PROMISING: All source/sample/economic/cost/fill/stress/capacity gates pass, 95% event/day clustered net lower bound > 0 per gross share day, incremental bound above best baseline > 0, independent #207 verification. Research-only; never automatically LIVE.
disposition_rules.REJECTED: Adequate independent sample establishes conservative upper CI for net economic return < = 0 (or hard invariant failure).
disposition_rules.INSUFFICIENT_DATA: Any required source/sample/fill/cost/latency/queue/exit/cluster input missing; report NULL, not zero.

risk_rule: No LIVE order, no new sender, no change to producer, execution, maker, global risk cap or model promotion; respect #209 -> #214 -> #223 branch stack.
capital_metric: profit per gross-share-day = verified realised net SUSQies / sum(abs(YES-equivalent live or reserved gross shares) * elapsed_seconds / 86400) over same exposure window; hypothetical 300s marks never satisfy.
data_notes: #220 lacks independently tracked SIG full-depth as at 2026-10-12
Historic #175 passive maker calibration 487.4 predicted vs 149 actual; cannot be used as verified empirical fill
test_requirements: gross cap and locked unresolved commitments
